The first public beta of binference, for macOS: an AI agent that trades on BNB Smart Chain for you. Linux and Windows come in later releases.
Talk to it in Telegram, the web console or the terminal. In the default manual mode, every trade comes as a card with its exact terms, and nothing moves until you confirm it.
Your agent starts in paper mode: real quotes, checks and cards, with no funds moved. Run binference live in Terminal to trade real money from its wallet.
/freeze or binference freeze stops everything at once. /rescue or binference rescue moves every agent wallet's funds to your rescue address once you confirm its card.
Your wallets stay in Privy under a ceiling only your owner key can change. In this beta, auto orders and webhook rules fill on paper only.
